'''Rubia''' is a female student from the Department of Voidmatters seen with a TAR-D Unit named '''Pikjo'''. She talks about her classmates, '''Erio''' and '''Sena'''. She wants to help her friends reconnect. 

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Idle==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:;'''Rubia''' You're a minute behind, Pikjo!
:;'''Rubia''' But that's okay—sometimes even the whole world moves slowly.
:;'''Rubia''' Or... You could try clapping to a beat.
:;'''Rubia''' ...
:;'''Rubia''' Just breathe, relax, and follow the wind's tempo.
:;'''Rubia''' Yes, just like that. Now the wind is your friend, too!

==Dialogue==
;(First time interacting)
:'''Rubia:''' Good, there we go.
:'''Rubia:''' Maybe try to keep up with Pikbo... even if it's a minute faster than the other TARD-Es.
:'''Rubia:''' Is that why you haven't seen each other as much lately?
:'''Rubia:''' Hmm... Though I suppose people who don't get along usually try to avoid each other.
:'''Rubia:''' ...Just like those two over there.
:'''Rubia:''' Oh, we have a new friend joining us!
:'''Rubia:''' Why don't we go over and say hello, Pikjo? Just remember to speak a little more softly and gently.
:{{DIcon}} Hello there.
:'''Pikjo:''' Hello, {{Rover}} of Rabelle College. Tardy to class: zero times. Late assignment submissions: zero.
:'''Pikjo:''' Keep up the good work.
:'''Rubia:''' That's amazing. How do you do it? I've missed morning classes nine times already this semester.
:'''Rubia:''' Hehe... at least Pikjo never gets mad at me.
:'''Pikjo:''' Rubia from the Department of Voidmatters. Tardy to class: nine times. Late assignment submissions: zero.
:'''Pikjo:''' Warning! Serious warning! Invalid warning...
:{{DIcon}} The semester's only just begun...
:'''Rubia:''' Huh? What?
:{{DIcon}} Um... Are you giving lessons to that TARD-E unit?
:{{DIcon}} Um... Are you teaching that TARD-E unit to sing?
:{{DIcon}} Um... Are you calibrating that TARD-E unit?
:'''Rubia:''' No, I'm apologizing to it.
:'''Rubia:''' Maybe Pikjo's gotten slower because I've been late so many times.
:'''Rubia:''' But if this continues... Pikjo and Pikbo will always be two minutes apart, and forever out of sync...
:'''Rubia:''' Just like Erio and Sena...
:{{DIcon}} Erio?
::'''Rubia:''' That boy over there with the light brown hair—That's Erio.
::'''Rubia:''' And Sena is the girl with the short hair over there.
:{{DIcon}} Sena?
::'''Rubia:''' That girl over there with the short hair—That's Sena.
::'''Rubia:''' And Erio is the boy with the light brown hair over there.
:'''Rubia:''' I think they had an argument.
:'''Rubia:''' But I'd say they're more like different alarm clocks.
:'''Rubia:''' It was so lively when they chimed together. But one day, one rang on the hour like always, while the other insisted on ringing a few minutes early.
:'''Rubia:''' Then... the ticking stopped, and the room fell quiet. 
:'''Rubia:''' ...{{Rover}}, maybe you could go see them when you have the time?
:'''Rubia:''' Maybe... they still want to mesh, but their gears need a gentle nudge to get moving again.
----
;(After completing {{Quest|Answers Only the Wind Knows}}
:'''Pikjo:''' Rubia from the Department of Voidmatters. Tardy to class: ten times. Late assignment submissions: zero.
:'''Pikbo:''' Warning! Serious warning!
:'''Pikjo:''' Invalid warning...
:'''Rubia:''' {{Rover}}!
:'''Rubia:''' Look, look! Pikjo and Pikbo are back together and boisterous as ever!
:{{DIcon}} You're right... They're totally in sync again.
::'''Rubia:''' Heh... Didn't I say it was only temporary? 
:{{DIcon}} Now they're giving you warnings together.
::'''Rubia:''' Hehe, sometimes it's good to have that sense of urgency.
:{{DIcon}} How were you late again...?
::'''Rubia:''' Huh? Did I break my old record?
:{{DIcon}} That reminds me, Erio and Sena...
::{{DIcon}} They seem to be back on good terms now.
:'''Rubia:''' Told you so! All they needed was a little time, an opportunity, and a pinch of courage.
:'''Rubia:''' Of course, the "wind" also did its part to help!
:{{DIcon}} 
:{{DIcon}} That is to say, you were the "wind" carrying the message?
:'''Rubia:''' Who, me? I didn't do a thing!
:{{DIcon}} Really? I'm not convinced.
:'''Rubia:''' Hm... Does making two frequencies with different waveforms briefly intersect at a certain moment count?
:'''Rubia:''' Erio and Sena... are dear friends of mine.
:'''Rubia:''' But they both take everything too seriously.
:'''Rubia:''' They were so afraid that listening to each other's heartbeat would cause them to fall out of lockstep.
:'''Rubia:''' At the very least, they needed to let the Platinheart Bloom blossom first. The heart's tempo can only be heard once all other noise is silenced.
:'''Rubia:''' Finally, it's like you said—Different notes can come together to form a beautiful melody.
:{{DIcon}} ...You really are a magician at work.
:'''Rubia:''' Well... you added a spell of your own, didn't you?
{{Dialogue End}}
